camel_example: aliyun pvtz DescribeChangeLogs --region cn-hangzhou --EntityType PV_ZONE --Keyword test --ZoneId df2d03865266bd9842306db586d30000 --PageSize 100 --PageNumber 1 --StartTimestamp 1516779348000 --UserClientIp '192.0.XX.XX' --Lang en --EndTimestamp 2516779348000
description_en: You can call the DescribeChangeLogs operation to retrieve the operation logs for a private zone. The logs record operations related to built-in authoritative zones, cache management, forwarding management, endpoints, and DNS record queries. You can perform a fuzzy search by keywords such as behavior and content
description_zh: 调用DescribeChangeLogs接口获取内网DNS解析操作日志。操作日志是记录内置权威、缓存管理、转发管理、服务地址以及查询解析记录的操作日志，可以根据行为、内容等关键字进行模糊查询
kebab_example: aliyun pvtz describe-change-logs --keyword test --lang en --zone-id df2d03865266bd9842306db586d30000 --page-number 1 --page-size 100 --start-timestamp 1516779348000 --end-timestamp 2516779348000 --entity-type PV_ZONE --user-client-ip 192.0.XX.XX --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeChangeLogs

parameters.help_en: The keyword, such as a behavior or content. Fuzzy search is supported. The keyword is not case-sensitive
parameters.help_zh: 关键字（行为、内容）。支持模糊查询，不区分大小写
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh: Chinese.

en: English.

Default value: en
parameters.help_zh:
返回值语言，取值：

zh：中文。

en：英文。

默认值：en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the zone. If you specify this parameter, the operation returns the change logs of DNS records for the specified zone.
If you leave this parameter empty, the operation returns the change logs of all zones and DNS records that belong to the current account
parameters.help_zh:
Zone ID。 是否为空： 若ZondId非空，则获取当前Zone的解析记录变更日志。
若ZoneId为空，则获取当前账户下所有Zone操作及Zone解析变更日志
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置查询的页码，起始值为 1，默认为 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页数据量，最大值 100，默认为 20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The start time. This value is a UNIX timestamp
parameters.name: start_timestamp

parameters.help_en: The end time. This value is a UNIX timestamp
parameters.name: end_timestamp

parameters.help_en:
The type of log to obtain. Valid values:

PV_ZONE: operation logs of built-in authoritative zones.

PV_RECORD: operation logs of DNS records.

RESOLVER_RULE: operation logs of forwarding rules.

CUSTOM_LINE: operation logs of custom lines.

RESOLVER_ENDPOINT: operation logs of outbound endpoints.

INBOUND_ENDPOINT: operation logs of inbound endpoints.

CACHE_RESERVE_DOMAIN: operation logs of domains for which cache is retained.

If you specify another value, this parameter is ignored and logs of all types are returned
parameters.help_zh:
获取的日志类型。取值：

PV_ZONE：内置权威zone的操作日志。
PV_RECORD：解析记录的操作日志。
RESOLVER_RULE：转发规则的操作日志。
CUSTOM_LINE：自定义线路的操作日志。
RESOLVER_ENDPOINT：出站终端节点的操作日志。
INBOUND_ENDPOINT：入站终端节点的操作日志。
CACHE_RESERVE_DOMAIN：缓存保持域名的操作日志。


其它值则忽略，获取所有类型日志
parameters.name: entity_type

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the user
parameters.name: user_client_ip

items.description_en: The details of a change log

Content.description_en: The content of the operation. This parameter records the specific details of the operation
Content.description_zh: 操作内容。记录本次操作的具体内容
Content.example: Add RR:test.03 Type:A Line:default TTL:300 Value:172.20.XX.XX

CreatorId.description_en: The ID of the operator who performed the operation
CreatorId.description_zh: 操作者ID。完成这个操作的实施人ID

CreatorSubType.description_en:
The subtype of the operator. Valid values:

CUSTOMER: an Alibaba Cloud account

SUB: a RAM user

STS: role assumption

OTHER: other
CreatorSubType.description_zh:
操作者子类型。取值：

CUSTOMER：主账号
SUB：子账号
STS：角色扮演
OTHER：其他

CreatorType.description_en: The type of the operator. The value can be empty or USER
CreatorType.description_zh: 操作者类型。取值为空或USER

EntityId.description_en: The unique ID of the entity, such as a domain name, custom line, forwarding rule, outbound endpoint, or inbound endpoint
EntityId.description_zh: 域名、自定义解析线路、转发规则、出站终端节点、入站终端节点等的唯一标识码

EntityName.description_en: The name of the operation object. The object can be a domain name, a custom line, a domain for which cache is retained, a forwarding rule, an outbound endpoint, or an inbound endpoint
EntityName.description_zh: 操作对象名称。指操作的主体，例如域名、自定义解析线路、缓存保持域名、转发规则、出站终端节点、入站终端节点

Id.description_en: The ID of the operation record

OperAction.description_en: The specific action performed on the object, such as add, delete, update, or associate
OperAction.description_zh: 对操作对象的具体操作行为，例如增加、删除、修改、关联等

OperIp.description_en: The IP address from which the change was initiated. This is a public IP address. If the operation was initiated from a device that uses a private IP address, this parameter indicates the public IP address of the device after Network Address Translation (NAT)
OperIp.description_zh: 操作本次变更的IP地址（公网IP，如果操作终端设备为私网IP，那此处记录的IP为用户终端NAT之后的公网IP）

OperObject.description_en:
The type of the operation object. Description:

PV_ZONE: a built-in authoritative zone.

PV_RECORD: a DNS record.

RESOLVER_RULE: a forwarding rule.

CUSTOM_LINE: a custom line.

RESOLVER_ENDPOINT: an outbound endpoint.

INBOUND_ENDPOINT: an inbound endpoint.

CACHE_RESERVE_DOMAIN: a domain for which cache is retained
OperObject.description_zh:
操作对象类型。说明：
PV_ZONE：内置权威zone。
PV_RECORD：解析记录。
RESOLVER_RULE：转发规则。
CUSTOM_LINE：自定义线路。
RESOLVER_ENDPOINT：出站终端节点。
INBOUND_ENDPOINT：入站终端节点。
CACHE_RESERVE_DOMAIN：缓存保持域名

OperTime.description_en: The time when the operation was performed

OperTimestamp.description_en: The time when the operation was performed. This value is a UNIX timestamp
OperTimestamp.description_zh: 操作发生的时间（时间戳）

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned data

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page

TotalPages.description_en: The total number of pages returned
